sentences.en: His fake moustache started to peel off on one side.
sentences.zh: 他一侧的假髭开始脱落了。

sentences.en: "Hrmm," mumbled Professor Takeda as he twisted his moustache.
sentences.zh: 田代教授一边捻着髭须一边咕哝道：‘嗯哼。’

sentences.en: Men with moustaches are more likely to make history.
sentences.zh: 留有髭须的人更容易创造历史。
